name: SightRadar Face Recognition API MCP
description: Official MCP server for the SightRadar face recognition API: index photos into collections, find every photo of a person from one selfie, compare and detect faces, run batches of up to 1,000 photo URLs, and manage webhooks, usage and credits. Local stdio server; needs a SightRadar API key.

SIGHTRADAR_API_KEY.description: SightRadar API key, created at https://sightradar.com/dashboard/keys.

SIGHTRADAR_SCOPES.description: Tool groups to expose: comma-separated read, search, write, delete, or all (adds account tools).

SIGHTRADAR_FILE_ROOTS.description: Folders the file_path argument may read (':'-separated on macOS/Linux, ';' on Windows); 'none' turns file_path off. Defaults to the home folder.
